gaps.name: Music / audio filter in the search scope bar
gaps.whatItIs: Modern ChatListSearchPaneContainerNode offers panes for chats, media, downloads, links, files, music and voice. Our scope bar stops at All / Media / Links / Files / Voice - there is no Music pane, so sent audio tracks are unfindable except by falling into the Files scope.
gaps.whyItMatters: Audio tracks shared in chats cannot be located at all; the Files filter (searchMessagesFilterDocument) does not return them.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGSearchViewController.m +scopeTitles and +filterForScope: add one title and one case returning "searchMessagesFilterAudio".
tdlib: searchMessages with searchMessagesFilterAudio - already wrapped and already documented in TGClient+Search.h

gaps.name: In-chat search restricted to one sender ("From:" chip)
gaps.whatItIs: In a group, modern search lets you pick a member and see only their messages matching the query, with the chosen member shown as a token in the search field.
gaps.whyItMatters: In a busy group, searching a common word is useless without narrowing by who said it. This is the single most-used group search affordance.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGSearchViewController.m chat-scoped path (loadChatMessagesPage:, _scopedChatId / _scopeChatButton area) - a second chip next to the existing chat scope chip, picking a member through the existing group-members list.
tdlib: searchChatMessages sender_id - already wrapped: -searchMessagesInChat:query:senderUserId:filter:fromMessageId:limit:completion:, but every call site passes 0

gaps.name: Jump to date in a chat history (calendar)
gaps.whatItIs: Modern search offers a calendar of days that have messages; picking a day scrolls the history to that day. Typing a date into search also surfaces a "jump to date" row.
gaps.whyItMatters: The only way to reach old messages in our client is scrolling or guessing a keyword. Long histories are effectively unreachable.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGChatViewController.m - a "Jump to date" entry in the chat action sheet opening a simple month grid; jump via the existing scrollToMessageId: path.
tdlib: getChatMessageCalendar - wrapped as -messageCalendarForChat:filter:fromMessageId:completion:, currently unused anywhere
getChatMessageByDate - wrapped as -messageInChat:closestToDate:completion:, currently unused anywhere

gaps.name: Date-range narrowing in global search
gaps.whatItIs: Modern global search accepts a date and narrows results to that period, shown alongside the chat-type filter.
gaps.whyItMatters: Global search over years of history returns a wall of hits; a period filter is what makes it usable. Our wrapper already takes minDate/maxDate but the UI always sends 0/0.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGSearchViewController.m loadGlobalMessagesPage: - reuse the existing chat-type action sheet pattern for a period picker (Any / last week / last month / a chosen year).

gaps.name: Frequently contacted peers row in the empty search state
gaps.whatItIs: ChatListSearchRecentPeersNode shows a horizontal strip of top/frequent contacts above the recent-searches list when the search field is empty.
gaps.whyItMatters: Search doubles as the fastest way to open a chat; without top peers the empty state only shows chats you previously found through search, which is a much narrower set.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGSearchViewController.m loadRecents / rebuildSections - a horizontal UIScrollView header section above the existing recents.
tdlib: getTopChats topChatCategoryUsers - already wrapped as -topChatsWithCompletion: in TGClient+ChatList.h, currently called from nowhere

gaps.name: Hashtag search scopes (This chat / My messages / Public posts)
gaps.whatItIs: Tapping a #hashtag in modern Telegram opens a screen with three tabs: occurrences in the current chat, in your own messages, and across public posts.
gaps.whyItMatters: We only ever run the public-posts search. Tapping a tag inside a group you follow gives you strangers' posts instead of that group's, which is the wrong answer most of the time.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGSearchViewController.m loadTagMessagesPage: plus the tag-tap handler in TGChatViewController.m - reuse the existing scope bar with three tag scopes.
tdlib: searchChatMessages with the tag as the query - wrapped
searchMessages restricted to own messages - wrapped

gaps.name: Shared media panes beyond photos and videos
gaps.whatItIs: Modern shared media splits a chat's history into Media / Files / Links / Music / Voice / GIFs tabs, each a filtered history list.
gaps.whyItMatters: TGMediaViewController.m hardcodes searchMessagesFilterPhotoAndVideo (line ~1089), so a chat's shared files, links and voice notes can only be reached through the global search screen, never from the chat's own profile.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGMediaViewController.m - a scope bar identical to the one in TGSearchViewController, swapping the filter string and switching between the grid layout and a plain list for non-visual types.
tdlib: searchChatMessages with each SearchMessagesFilter - all wrapped and documented in TGClient+Search.h

gaps.name: Multi-select on search results
gaps.whatItIs: ChatListSearchMessageSelectionPanelNode lets you select several search hits and forward or delete them in one go, without opening each chat.
gaps.whyItMatters: Collecting scattered messages (photos of a trip, a set of files) currently means opening each chat and forwarding one at a time.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGSearchViewController.m - the table already implements editing for recents; add a select mode driving the existing TGForwardPicker.

gaps.name: Date indicator while fast-scrolling shared media
gaps.whatItIs: Dragging the media grid's scrollbar shows a floating month label, driven by sparse message positions rather than by loading the whole history.
gaps.whyItMatters: A chat with thousands of photos scrolls blind; without a date hint you cannot aim at a period. The cheap sparse API exists precisely so a 512MB device need not load everything.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGMediaViewController.m - a small floating label updated during scrollViewDidScroll.

gaps.name: Downloads pane in search
gaps.whatItIs: A pane listing files currently downloading and recently downloaded, with pause/resume and a total-size header.
gaps.whyItMatters: Marginal here: our client downloads on demand into a small cache and has a storage screen already, and a 4S with 40-60MB of usable RAM is not a file-hoarding device. Listed only so a later wave does not re-audit it.
gaps.whereItGoes: would be a fifth section of TGSearchViewController.m, overlapping the existing storage screen
